body:
## Pull request overview

This PR introduces a “design mode” for dashboard preview selection so users can click widgets in the rendered dashboard preview to select/deselect them and keep selection in sync with the right-side editor panel.

**Changes:**
- Add design-mode selection props to `DashboardRenderer` and implement click + keyboard selection/deselection affordances.
- Add external (controlled) widget selection props to `DashboardEditor` and wire selection sync in `DashboardView`.
- Add unit/integration tests covering renderer/editor/view selection sync, and update `ROADMAP.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/DashboardEditor.externalSelection.test.tsx | Adds tests for externally controlled widget selection in the editor. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/DashboardEditor.tsx | Adds `selectedWidgetId`/`onWidgetSelect` props and controlled/uncontrolled selection behavior. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.designMode.test.tsx | Adds tests for design-mode selection, keyboard nav, and deselection behaviors. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx | Implements design-mode widget wrappers, selection styling, click-to-select/deselect, and keyboard navigation. |
| apps/console/src/components/DashboardView.tsx | Shares `selectedWidgetId` state between preview renderer and editor drawer to sync selection. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/DashboardViewSelection.test.tsx | Integration tests for end-to-end selection sync between preview/editor and autosave behavior. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents Phase 6 “Design Mode Preview Click-to-Select”. |
</details>

`DashboardWidgetSchema.id` is optional, but design mode props are built unconditionally from `widget.id` (test id, data-widget-id, role/tabIndex, handlers). If `id` is missing, the element becomes focusable and labeled but can’t be selected (`handleWidgetClick` returns when `widgetId` is falsy). Consider only applying the interactive design-mode props when `widget.id` is present (or ensuring widgets always have stable ids before enabling selection).

`onClick={handleBackgroundClick}` is set before `{...props}` on the mobile root container, so a consumer-provided `onClick` in `props` will override the background deselect handler and break click-to-deselect. Consider spreading `props` before attaching `onClick`, or composing the handlers so both run.

`onClick={handleBackgroundClick}` is set before `{...props}` on the desktop grid container, so a consumer-provided `onClick` in `props` will override the background deselect handler and break click-to-deselect. Consider spreading `props` before attaching `onClick`, or composing the handlers so both run.

Design mode renders widgets with `role="button"` but also sets `aria-selected`. `aria-selected` isn’t valid for the button role and may be ignored/flagged by a11y tooling. Consider using a semantic `<button>` element, or switch to `aria-pressed`, or adopt listbox/option roles if you want to keep `aria-selected`.
```suggestion
            'aria-pressed': isSelected,
```
